subject: Consolidate MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA, SCCs & role tie-outs
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidate MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA, SCCs & role tie-outs

Ben/Laura — sending a consolidated packet from the MedSys commercial/technical thread so legal and ops can align on the outstanding DPA/GDPR items before we push to procurement. Summary: MedSys wants to sign this month but has three asks that touch the MSA, Order Form and the DPA/SCCs annex. I attached a combined redline package (DPA_Redline_v2 + OrderForm_v3-markup + proposed SCCs spreadsheet).

Key open items (high level):
- Roles: MedSys is pushing for Controller/Controller-like language on certain telemetry logs; we need to confirm processor-only scope (and an explicit carveout if they insist).
- SCCs annex: they want to accept the new EU SCCs but require an explicit subprocessor approval flow and updated subprocessors list.
- Transfer impact addendum: they flagged two countries where they need a data residency commitment for initial pilot. They asked about Private Deployment (VPC/on-prem) as an alternative — flagged to ops.
- Order Form: pricing/term interplay for private deployment and KMS-backed key options needs a short clause in the Order Form (they want optionality documented).

Ask: Laura — can you review the DPA redline and confirm whether we can accept the suggested language on Roles (see section 2.1–2.3) or whether we should propose the processor-only fallback we discussed. Also, please review the SCCs annex (tab "Subprocessors") for whether we should pre-approve the MedSys list or require a 10-business-day notice process.
Ben — can you loop in Infra/Cloud ops if private deployment is requested; note the two pilot regions (EU-West and CH) where they may request on-prem routing.

Plan: aiming for a revised redline by EOD tomorrow (11/11) to share back. If we can settle controller/processor framing and the subprocessor process, procurement will circulate PO + DocuSign link.

Attachments: DPA_Redline_v2.docx (docx), OrderForm_v3-markup.pdf (pdf), SCCs-Annex-draft.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Nikhil
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medsys.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco.li@medsys.io>, MedSys Procurement <procurement@medsys.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidate MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA, SCCs & role tie-outs

Nikhil — thanks for the packet. Quick replies inline.

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 10:12 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com> wrote:
> Key open items (high level):
> - Roles: MedSys is pushing for Controller/Controller-like language on certain telemetry logs; we need to confirm processor-only scope (and an explicit carveout if they insist).

We are indeed requesting a modest modification to the Roles clause to reflect limited controller duties for diagnostic telemetry tied to patient safety incidents. This is narrow and clearly scoped; attaching a short excerpt as proposed language. Our legal is willing to accept a processor fallback if Redwood proposes an audit/right-to-verify mechanism for the telemetry subset.

> - SCCs annex: they want to accept the new EU SCCs but require an explicit subprocessor approval flow and updated subprocessors list.

Procurement: we need an explicit approval flow and a list of subprocessors. We can accept a 10-business-day notice + objection window (like you proposed) as long as the contract states Redwood must honor reasonable security objections.

> - Transfer impact addendum: they flagged two countries where they need a data residency commitment for initial pilot. They asked about Private Deployment (VPC/on-prem) as an alternative — flagged to ops.

We prefer to keep option for Private Deployment in the Order Form. If Redwood can confirm timing and incremental pricing, we can sign the MSA and list the Private Deployment addendum as an appendix to the Order Form.

Next steps: Marco (cc) is our procurement lead — Marco, can we get the PO approval timeline? We are targeting to sign by 11/20 if contract language is reasonable.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Legal Operations
MedSys

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@medsys.io>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidate MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA, SCCs & role tie-outs

Elena / Nikhil — thanks for the detail and proposed wording, Elena. I reviewed DPA_Redline_v2 and the SCCs spreadsheet. High-level legal position and proposed fixes below.

1) Roles (Controller vs Processor)
- We will not accept broad controller language. However, we can accept a narrowly scoped exception that: (a) identifies the specific telemetry data elements, (b) limits MedSys use to patient-safety incident response, and (c) requires prior written notice for any new use case.
- Proposed redline: add a short carveout clause in Section 2.2; I placed the exact language in DPA_Redline_v2 (track changes). Please confirm the telemetry element list — current proposal includes: crash logs, anonymized model inputs for debugging, and timestamped processing metadata.

2) Subprocessor approval flow & SCCs annex
- 10-business-day notice + opportunity to object is acceptable, provided objections are reasonable and presented with specific security basis. We propose a fallback: if an objection is raised, both parties must meet within 5 business days to attempt remediation; if unresolved, the parties may agree on mitigation or termination for that sub-processor only.
- I updated SCCs-Annex-draft.xlsx with a "Pre-Approved" column for the subprocessors Redwood can commit to (initial list) and a separate "Notice-only" bucket. Please review.

3) Transfer impact addendum / Private deployment
- We can include an Order Form field for "Deployment Option" (Hosted / Private VPC / On‑prem) and a pricing delta schedule. For the two pilot regions (EU-West, Switzerland) we can include a 90-day ramp commitment for Private Deployment; full on-prem will require a separate SOW. Ops: Ben, can you confirm feasibility and estimated lead-times for EU-West VPC and CH on-prem pilot?

4) KMS / encryption and audit logs
- We will offer KMS-backed keys for private deployments (customer-managed KMS incur a one-time setup fee); for hosted we propose BYOK availability on Premium Tier. Audit logs: we can provide export of tenant activity logs on request for compliance reviews (standard SLA).

I attached an updated DPA_Redline_v2 (with tracked language) and the SCCs annex draft. If you accept these proposals, we can finalize redlines and circulate DocuSign + procurement PO.

Attachments referenced: DPA_Redline_v2.docx (updated), SCCs-Annex-draft.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medsys.io>, Marco Li <marco.li@medsys.io>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: MedSys Procurement <procurement@medsys.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidate MSA + Order Form redlines: DPA, SCCs & role tie-outs

Elena/Marco — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear asks. Confirming Redwood's operational commitments and next steps below.

Action items we agree to:
1) Roles: Accept narrow telemetry carveout as proposed by Laura. Redwood will add the carveout language to Section 2.2 and publish the specific telemetry element list as an exhibit.
2) Subprocessors/SCCs: We accept the 10-business-day notice + objection process with the 5-business-day meet-to-remediate fallback. Attached: SCCs-Annex-draft.xlsx (finalized pre-approve bucket).
3) Private Deployment: We will list "Deployment Option" on the Order Form. For EU-West VPC pilot we can provision within ~4 weeks after PO; CH on-prem routing will require a separate SOW and longer lead time (estimated 8–10 weeks). Pricing deltas included in OrderForm_v3-markup.pdf.
4) KMS: BYOK available on Premium; customer-managed KMS for Private Deployment requires a setup fee of $8k and a small monthly support surcharge (documented in OrderForm_v3).

Next steps:
- Marco: if OK, please confirm PO ETA and whether you want DocuSign now (we can push DocuSign envelope as soon as legal confirms final acceptance).
- Legal: Laura will produce the final DPA (redline accepted) and SCCs annex; we will route for signature.

Tentative timeline: sign by 11/20 if procurement confirms PO this week.

Thanks all — pleased we could converge.

Ben Carter
Director, Contracts & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
